_status: The learner guide's worked example (Module 2 learner guide, pages 8 and 9): citizen and staff outside, 2 steps, 1 store, 2 trust boundaries. The three worked threats are the guide's; the others are extra examples for clicking.

Staff check the list and confirm

letters.plain: data seen by the wrong people

letters.name: Elevation of privilege
letters.plain: getting powers you should not have

threats.threat: Someone books in another person's name and number.
threats.control: A one-time code sent to the mobile number.

threats.threat: The list is shared by a public link.
threats.control: Access only for named staff accounts.

threats.threat: Automated fake bookings fill every slot.
threats.control: Limit bookings per number; a human check.

threats.threat: Someone on the same public Wi-Fi reads the booking details.
Someone changes or deletes bookings in the list.
threats.control: Edit rights for named staff only; keep the change history.

threats.threat: A booking is cancelled and nobody can say who did it.
threats.control: Named accounts, and a log of who confirms or cancels.

threats.threat: A citizen opens the staff view by changing the page address.
threats.control: Check the user's role on every staff page.

threats.threat: Someone signs in as staff with a guessed password.
